subject: AI & Agents
title: What Is a Prompt?
description: A 60-second lesson on What Is a Prompt?.

hook.text: The difference between a useless AI response and a brilliant one is often just how you asked.

buildup.text: A prompt is the text input you give to an LLM — your question, instruction, or context.

discovery.text: Good prompts are specific, provide context, and state the desired format clearly.

twist.text: Adding 'think step by step' to a prompt can dramatically improve reasoning accuracy.

climax.text: Prompt engineering is now a real skill. Companies hire specialists to craft optimal prompts.

punchline.text: The art of AI isn't in the model. It's in the question.

quiz.question: What makes a prompt effective?
options: Being specific, providing context, and stating the desired format
Using as few words as possible

details.summary: A prompt is the text input sent to a language model to generate a response. Prompt engineering — crafting effective prompts — has become a crucial skill as the quality of the prompt directly determines the quality of AI output.
details.whyItMatters: The prompt is the primary interface between humans and language models. Mastering prompt design unlocks dramatically better AI results without any technical changes to the underlying model.
takeaways: A prompt is the text input that instructs the language model
Prompt quality directly determines output quality
Prompt engineering is a skill that dramatically improves AI results

faq.question: What makes a good prompt?
faq.answer: Clear instructions, specific context, desired output format, and relevant examples. Good prompts are unambiguous about what is wanted. They specify constraints, provide background, and show the expected style of response.

faq.question: Is prompt engineering a real skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The difference between naive and expert prompts can be dramatic. Companies hire prompt engineers, and systematic techniques like chain-of-thought, few-shot examples, and structured outputs reliably improve results.
